title: How can thermoelectric coupling catalysis be applied to facilitate biomass conversion into value-added products and hydrogen?
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00320B, Tutorial Review
Hao Chang, Xuesong Liu, Ao Xia, Wenlei Zhu, Junyi Ji, Xianqing Zhu, Jingmiao Zhang, Yun Huang, Xun Zhu, Qiang Liao
This review offers a comprehensive insight into thermoelectrocatalytic biomass conversion, showing how thermal–electrical synergy enables co-production of high-value chemicals and hydrogen, while outlining design strategies and industrial challenges.
